title: Warranty Labor Rates, Parts Markup and Claim Time Limits (Warranty and Safety Recall Coverage)
content:
# Store Reimbursement Rates and Claim Time Limits

For claims under the Warranty and Safety Recall Coverage, the manufacturer reimburses each store a warranty labor rate per hour, set by store code, and a markup over dealer cost on warranty parts, expressed as a fraction. Each coverage type also fixes how many calendar days after the repair order closes the store has to submit a claim, and how many calendar days after payment the manufacturer may debit a claim on audit.

## Warranty labor rate reimbursed, by store (USD per hour)

The same store rates apply under all seven coverage types.

| Store code | Rate per hour |
|---|---|
| KTD | 168.00 |
| KHB | 161.00 |
| KFS | 159.00 |
| KCF | 154.00 |
| KHR | 139.00 |
| KCV | 149.00 |

## Parts markup and time limits by coverage type

| Coverage type | Parts markup over dealer cost | Claim submission (calendar days after the repair order closes) | Audit debit window (calendar days after payment) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Kessler Used Vehicle Limited Warranty | 0.0 (0%) | 30 | 0 |
| Factory Complimentary Maintenance | 0.4 (40%) | 30 | 365 |
| Factory Basic Limited Warranty | 0.4 (40%) | 30 | 365 |
| Factory Powertrain Limited Warranty | 0.4 (40%) | 30 | 365 |
| Certified Pre-Owned Powertrain Warranty | 0.4 (40%) | 30 | 365 |
| Federal Emissions Performance Warranty | 0.4 (40%) | 30 | 365 |
| Safety Recall Remedy Coverage | 0.4 (40%) | 30 | 365 |

## Worked figures on hypothetical inputs

- **Parts.** A warranty part with a hypothetical dealer cost of 50.00 is reimbursed at dealer cost plus a markup of 0.4 of that cost, that is 50.00 plus 20.00, or 70.00, under a coverage type with a 40% markup; under the Kessler Used Vehicle Limited Warranty, with a markup of 0.0, it is reimbursed at 50.00.
- **Labor.** At a store whose rate in the table were a hypothetical 100.00 an hour, 2.0 hours of manufacturer labor time would be reimbursed at 200.00.
